body.name: Marked-process multiplier-band handle
body.construction: \(\mathscr H_{\mathrm{MB}}\) starts from one joint counting-process martingale representation for the marked readmission, death, and estimated-censoring primitive vector through \(\tau\); it then composes increment-level multipliers with the active deadline cut \(u_x^\star\) and the quotient map defining \(\theta_\nu\), and integrates the resulting TV process for \(\rho_\nu\).
